As a member of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, he is responsible for maintaining and fielding heavy dwarven war machines, specifically his own siege engine, Jetsteam. Stationed just outside the bustling halls of Ironforge at Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz represents the mechanical backbone of the dwarven military. Piloting the powerful siege engine known as Jetsteam, Bellowfiz spends his days tuning components, procuring essential parts, and keeping his machine battle-ready. Alongside his comrade Pilot Stonegear, Bellowfiz is constantly discussing vehicular designs, armor plating, and engine output, ensuring that the mountain kingdom's mechanized firepower remains unmatched across Khaz Modan.

npc:pilot-hammerfoot.text: Pilot Hammerfoot. Pilot Hammerfoot is a dwarven siege engine pilot of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, stationed near the mountain passes connecting Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Worried for a fellow pilot lost in the hills, he seeks willing adventurers to search for his friend. His presence highlights the dangers faced by dwarves along the high alpine ridges. Ironforge's siege engines are the pride of its Siege Brigade, but driving them across harsh mountainous terrain carries extreme risk. Stationed at the North Gate Outpost overlooking the border between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan, Pilot Hammerfoot guards the pilots' engines and watches the mountain passes. When a pilot goes missing, finding him quickly becomes a priority, especially with savage beasts prowling the nearby hills.

npc:pilot-longbeard.text: Pilot Longbeard. Pilot Longbeard is a dwarven siege engine pilot of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, stationed in the Hall of Arms within Ironforge's Military Ward. Though posted in the mountain city, he maintains close ties with gnomish tinkerers and fellow racing enthusiasts operating far away in the Shimmering Flats. Found amongst the martial displays and weaponsmiths of Ironforge's Military Ward, Pilot Longbeard represents the proud siege engine corps of Khaz Modan. While his duties keep him within the fortress city, Longbeard keeps an eager ear out for innovations and news from fellow mechanics across the continent, including the Brassbolts brothers tinkering out on the salt flats of Kalimdor. Longbeard serves as a point of contact for adventurous travelers heading south into Kalimdor. He frequently directs promising recruits and couriers toward the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles, where gnomish inventors push mechanical boundaries alongside their goblin rivals.

npc:pilot-stonegear.text: Pilot Stonegear. Pilot Stonegear, nicknamed 'Stone', is a dwarf mechanic and driver in the Ironforge Siege Brigade stationed at Steelgrill's Depot. He operates the formidable siege engine known as Trollplow and works tirelessly to enhance its performance and armor. Adventurers traveling through Dun Morogh often help him secure rare materials to keep his war machine battle-ready. Stationed among the rumbling boilers and clanking tracks of Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear serves Ironforge as a proud driver in the Siege Brigade. His pride and joy is Trollplow, a heavy siege tank built to smash through enemy lines. Stonegear takes his machine seriously—knowing that in the heat of battle, a driver's life depends entirely on the resilience of gears, plates, and steam pressure. He constantly seeks to fine-tune both Trollplow's combat efficiency and the everyday livability of its cramped cockpit. Like many dwarven and gnomish grease-monkeys at the depot, Stonegear is rarely content with factory specifications. He often spends off-duty hours debating engineering schematics with comrades like Pilot Bellowfiz. Whether chasing down rumors of exotic ores or tracking down volatile minerals to fuel enhanced plating and munitions, Stonegear relies on eager recruits to venture into the snowy wilderness and dangerous caves of Dun Morogh on supply runs.

npc:pixel.text: Pixel. Pixel is an enterprising goblin courier operating out of Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. Making her living delivering heavy goods across dangerous territories, she handles shipments like Warsong saw blades for the local Horde forces—though she never lets any cargo go without proper compensation. While Splintertree Post serves as a fortified bastion for the Horde amidst the hostile canopies of Ashenvale, Pixel remains firmly focused on profit. As an independent courier willing to haul freight into active war zones, she provides essential logistics for the Warsong Clan's logging efforts. However, true to goblin custom, contracts and coin dictate her cooperation. She holds fast to her deliveries until the client produces payment; for the saw blades, she wants a deadly blunderbuss to protect herself on the road. Always alert to an opportunity, she also pays passing adventurers for satyr horns, which are in high demand in Ratchet.

npc:piznik.text: Piznik. Piznik is a disgruntled goblin surveyor hiding deep within Windshear Mine in the Stonetalon Mountains. Once a high-ranking overseer in the local Venture Company operations, he was sidelined by the ruthless Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle. Now nursing a grudge, Piznik secretly gathers intel to undermine his former workplace. Before Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle seized supreme authority over Windshear Crag, Piznik held the enviable title of second-in-command across the entire operation. However, corporate restructuring in the Venture Company is unforgiving. Once Gerenzo took full control, Piznik found himself pushed aside and relegated to the murky depths of Windshear Mine. Rather than accepting his demotion quietly, Piznik bides his time underground, keeping a watchful eye on mine movements and quietly plotting revenge against the boss who demoted him.

npc:pozzik.text: Pozzik. Pozzik is an esteemed goblin tinkerer and racer stationed at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. Once one of the most respected engineers in Undermine, he now dedicates his technical genius to constructing experimental rocket cars and settling the ultimate debate of engineering supremacy against his gnome counterpart. Before retiring to the harsh salt flats of Thousand Needles, Pozzik built a legendary reputation among the goblins. As one of the most respected tinkerers out of Undermine, his technical expertise spans complex internal combustion, propulsion, and hazardous chassis construction. Rather than settling into comfortable obscurity, however, Pozzik took his mechanical mastery into the desert to push high-speed machinery far past its breaking point. At the Mirage Raceway, Pozzik teamed up with his perennial gnome counterpart, Fizzle Brassbolts. Despite the historic rivalry between goblin explosives and delicate gnomish calibration, the two worked together to construct the sprawling racetrack across the dried lakebed. They field opposing racing outfits, testing prototype rocket cars to definitively prove whose racial design philosophy dominates the track. Naturally, Pozzik is always on the lookout for resourceful adventurers willing to acquire parts and shave weight off his designs.

npc:priestess-a-moora.text: Priestess A'moora. Priestess A'moora is a devout night elf servant of the Moon Goddess residing within the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Working closely under the guidance of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind's priesthood, she attends to rituals of spiritual purification and communion with Elune. Travelers exploring Teldrassil are often directed to her when matters involve sacred offerings and the mystical wildlife of the boughs. Within the serene marble halls of the Temple of the Moon, Priestess A'moora spends her days in contemplation and service. As an ordained priestess of Elune, she assists in tending the spiritual needs of Darnassus and preserving the delicate rituals passed down through millennia. While much of the Sisterhood oversees military defenses or diplomacy, A'moora focuses on traditional devotions and sacred matters concerning the natural spirits of Teldrassil. A'moora is tied to the sad fate of Lady Sathrah, a great spider once beloved of Elune whose silvery dew was kept in the temple for its healing powers. When Sathrah descended into madness, A'moora sent young adventurers to the northern borders of Teldrassil near Wellspring Lake to end her suffering and bring back her silvery spinnerets. Offered at the temple's fountain, the spinnerets become a sacrifice to Elune so that Sathrah might be reborn at peace.

npc:priestess-anetta.text: Priestess Anetta. Inside Northshire Abbey, Priestess Anetta teaches new priests their first rites of the Holy Light. She is a human cleric and a member of the Brotherhood of Northshire. On the ground floor of Northshire Abbey, Priestess Anetta keeps to the quiet library wing. Defias bandits and kobolds trouble the valley, and she reminds those who pass that the Light may be the one thing that saves them someday. New human priests come to Priestess Anetta in the cloister with a hallowed letter of introduction. She teaches them to channel holy words to mend flesh and call down smiting radiance against evil. Under her guidance, the young acolytes prepare to carry the Light beyond Northshire's secluded walls.

npc:priestess-josetta.text: Priestess Josetta. In Goldshire, Priestess Josetta guides young priests beyond their first trials in Northshire. She teaches faith, devotion, and the work of serving others. Priestess Josetta tends to the people of Elwynn Forest from an upstairs room in the Lion's Pride Inn. Travelers, guards, and local workers come within her reach there. She offers spiritual care among ordinary folk, showing that service to the Holy Light can be given wherever people need comfort. Priestess Josetta guides young priests who have finished their first studies at Northshire Abbey. She sends them into the countryside to help wounded guards and comfort those who suffer. Their work teaches them that priesthood asks more than prayers learned by heart. They must put the Light to work and help mend a broken world. Priestess Josetta regrets that she did not travel farther when she was young. She chose familiar ground over the wider roads of Azeroth. Though she is content with her sacred service in Goldshire, she urges the young disciples who visit her to be bolder and carry their faith to distant frontiers.

npc:prospector-ironband.text: Prospector Ironband. Prospector Darteus Ironband is an honest, hardworking dwarven surveyor who oversees an archaeological dig in southeastern Loch Modan. Working under the banner of the Dwarven Explorers' Guild, he is determined to uncover the earthen heritage buried beneath Khaz Modan. Despite setbacks and hostile local creatures, Ironband remains committed to sending regular progress reports and uncovered relics back to Ironforge. Darteus Ironband leads the dig at Ironband's Excavation Site nestled in the hills of southeastern Loch Modan. Like many field researchers in the Explorers' Guild, Ironband believes that the soil of Khaz Modan hides vital truths about the origins of the dwarven race. His camp works tirelessly digging trenches and sifting through rubble in search of ancient relics, stone tablets, and earthen artifacts. Despite the slow pace of unearthing buried history, Ironband's resolve remains unshaken, and he is always eager to recruit competent adventurers to safeguard his operation. Conducting an excavation in the rugged wilds is never quiet. The site faces relentless harassment from local troggs and wildlife, threatening the supply lines and equipment essential for the dig. Relics and valuable survey equipment are constantly at risk of being stolen or wrecked before they can be examined. Ironband relies on visiting Alliance travelers to protect the cargo shipments, keep hostile raiders at bay, and investigate missing guild contacts in the neighboring badlands.

npc:prospector-remtravel.text: Prospector Remtravel. In southern Darkshore, Prospector Remtravel leads an Explorers' League dig among ancient relics. The dwarf's scattered focus and the dangers around camp make his work perilous. The Explorers' League sent Prospector Remtravel across the sea to establish a dig in southern Darkshore. Night elves guard their ancestral lands, yet the League's drive to uncover Azeroth's origins carries its prospectors into forgotten places. Remtravel unearths fossilized history and ancient stones, while aggressive wildlife and hostile local threats make the camp difficult for one scatterbrained dwarf to manage.

npc:prospector-ryedol.text: Prospector Ryedol. Prospector Ryedol is an Explorers' League surveyor stationed on a dusty rise overlooking the eastern Badlands. Watching over the perilous excavations below, he strives to recover lost dwarven relics and maintain hope in a barren wasteland overrun by troggs and beasts. Perched upon a rugged hill just south of Hammertoe's Digsite, Prospector Ryedol represents the ongoing efforts of Ironforge's Explorers' League in the Badlands. The arid valley is rich in ancient titan secrets and earthen heritage, but field expeditions here are constantly beleaguered by savage troggs, ravenous coyotes, and territorial drakes. Ryedol coordinates retrieval efforts for dwarven gear stolen by the Dark Iron dwarves and seeks signs of hope amid the ruined outposts, determined not to let the League's sacrifices in the wastes be in vain.

npc:prospector-stormpike.text: Prospector Stormpike. Prospector Stormpike is a blunt, short-tempered dwarf stationed within the Library of the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. A member of the renowned Stormpike clan, he oversees logistical support for distant archaeological digs and lends his sharp intellect to deciphering coded missives. Tucked away amid the towering bookshelves of the Hall of Explorers, Prospector Stormpike coordinates excavation efforts across Khaz Modan and beyond. Despite his gruff demeanor and impatience with idle chatter, he is deeply dedicated to uncovering dwarven history, keeping distant sites supplied with essentials like blasting powder. Beneath his rough exterior lies a keen analytical mind skilled at breaking intricate ciphers, making him an unexpected asset to Alliance scouts dealing with clandestine threats.

npc:prospector-whelgar.text: Prospector Whelgar. Prospector Whelgar is a dwarven archaeologist stationed at an excavation site in the Wetlands east of Menethil Harbor. His mission to uncover titan relics has stalled after vicious raptors overran the dig. He now seeks hardy adventurers willing to brave the beasts to recover ancient artifacts. Sent into the marshy wilderness of the Wetlands to unearth the history of the dwarven race, Prospector Whelgar established an archaeological camp known as Whelgar's Excavation Site. The valley was once rich with ancient stone relics, but the local raptors quickly grew territorial and drove his team into hiding. Despite the danger, Whelgar refuses to abandon his duty. He remains focused on recovering valuable relics—including the enigmatic Goaz Stone—before wild predators or rival scoundrels ruin the site entirely.

npc:quartermaster-lewis.text: Quartermaster Lewis. At Sentinel Hill in Westfall, Quartermaster Lewis keeps supplies moving to the People's Militia. He serves local defenders and travelers holding the frontier against the Defias Brotherhood. Quartermaster Lewis keeps the militia's supplies in Sentinel Tower. Stormwind's royal leaders offer little aid to impoverished Westfall, so Sentinel Hill depends on local volunteers and whatever provisions they can gather. Lewis hands out field necessities, including dry rations, fresh water, arrows, shot, and throwing blades. The fighters standing watch need these basics to endure Defias raids.

npc:quinn-yorick.text: Quinn Yorick. Quinn Yorick is a wounded Forsaken scout sheltering on the upper floor of a ruined farmhouse in the Ivar Patch. Having barely survived an encounter with the ghoul known as Ivar the Foul, he now relies on passing allies to help secure his survival. Tucked away inside an abandoned home at the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick lies gravely injured upstairs. His condition is the result of a vicious clash with Ivar the Foul, a ghoul lurking in the farm's barn in the northern stretches of Silverpine Forest. Sent with his sister Rane to scout Silverpine and report to High Executor Hadrec, Quinn cannot finish his mission or safely retreat alone, so he remains in hiding while travelers working for the Forsaken bring him healing and deal with the creature that nearly tore him apart.

npc:ragnar-thunderbrew.text: Ragnar Thunderbrew. Ragnar Thunderbrew is a dwarven brewer and co-owner of the renowned Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Known across Dun Morogh for serving his family's signature Beer Basted Boar Ribs, he works constantly to keep the busy tavern stocked and its patrons satisfied. Standing inside the Thunderbrew Distillery at Kharanos, Ragnar Thunderbrew manages the establishment's culinary reputation alongside his family's brewing operations. The distillery is a central gathering place for local mountaineers, traveling adventurers, and gnome refugees fleeing Gnomeregan. Chief among his duties is preparing the family's renowned Beer Basted Boar Ribs, a hearty Dun Morogh specialty cooked with stout dwarven ale. However, maintaining steady supplies has become difficult; his usual meat provider enlisted in the King's Army, leaving Ragnar dependent on wandering mountaineers and hunters to keep fresh crag boar flanks coming into the kitchen. The Thunderbrew name is synonymous with dwarven alcohol and pub culture throughout Ironforge territory. Ragnar has kept the family distillery running since his older brother, Grimbooze Thunderbrew, disappeared in a drunken haze a few harvests ago, defending the family's fiercely guarded brewing heritage against thieves like the Dark Iron dwarves, who stole the recipe for Thunderbrew Lager. Between restless patrons, missing supply lines, and rowdy tavern disputes, Ragnar keeps a steady hand on the taps, ensuring no traveler departs Kharanos with an empty mug or an empty belly.

npc:rahauro.text: Rahauro. Rahauro is a tauren attendant found on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, faithfully serving the elder crone Magatha Grimtotem. Acting on her behalf, he recruits brave adventurers to venture into the volcanic depths of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. He coordinates efforts to retaliate against the hostile troggs and recover missing possessions belonging to his mistress's fallen agents. Standing loyally near Magatha Grimtotem on the high terrace of Elder Rise, Rahauro acts as her direct intermediary. Magatha often operates through trusted underlings rather than soiling her own hooves with public recruitment. When reports emerge of wild creatures swarming beneath the orcish capital, it is Rahauro who handles the logistical details, dispatching Horde mercenaries to deal with the uprising. The troggs infesting the subterranean caverns of Ragefire Chasm did not respond kindly to diplomatic outreach. Magatha originally dispatched envoys in an attempt to forge peace with the primitive beasts, but the troggs turned violently on the delegates and butchered them. Viewing them as an intolerable threat to the Horde, Rahauro directs champions into the caverns to cull the troggs and assess their true strength.

npc:raleigh-andrean.text: Raleigh Andrean. Raleigh Andrean is a Forsaken resident of the Undercity. His requests reveal a callous attitude toward his former human life and those he once knew. Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, Raleigh Andrean lived an ordinary human life, married to a woman named Deliah and keeping company with his friend Valdred Moray. Like countless others, he fell when the Scourge tore through the kingdom, only to be raised as a mindless thrall in service to the Lich King. He regained his free will following the shattering of the Ner'zhul's grip and Sylvanas Windrunner's uprising, taking his place among the Forsaken in the Undercity.

npc:randis.text: Randis. In Cathedral Square, Randis waits for a chance to see the world beyond Stormwind. During Children's Week, he eagerly joins willing adventurers across Alliance lands. Randis lives in the orphanage near Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, one of many children left without family by the realm's conflicts. When Children's Week comes each year, Orphan Matron Nightingale gives sympathetic heroes a whistle and entrusts them with his care. Curious and full of questions, Randis dreams of adventure, asks riddles, and declares that he wants to be king of Stormwind when he grows up. For Randis, who spends most days in Cathedral Square, leaving the capital is a grand adventure. He remarks that places like Ironforge smell odd, and his wonder shows what Alliance heroes fight to protect.

npc:ranger-glynda-nal-shea.text: Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea. Near Auberdine's watch, Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea directs the defense of Darkshore. The seasoned night elf sentry sends travelers to meet threats and investigate strange signs along the coast. From Auberdine, Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea coordinates scouts as corruption grows and hostile forces press into Darkshore. She watches the wilderness around town and relies on capable travelers to guard the perimeter and protect night elf holdings along the coast. Glynda watches for dangers gathering along the shore, especially the bolder murlocs south of town. She oversees bounties on threats such as Murkdeep and sends scouts to examine strange finds, including a crimson crystal reported near Darkshore's eastern mountain range.

npc:rau-cliffrunner.text: Rau Cliffrunner. Rau Cliffrunner is a tauren scout and scholar stationed high atop Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. Dedicated to protecting his people from regional threats, he studies the history and origins of the hostile Galak centaur through their ancient relics. Working closely with allies in Thunder Bluff, Rau coordinates ventures into dangerous enemy strongholds across the canyon. Perched on the perilous bluffs of Freewind Post, Rau Cliffrunner maintains a watchful eye over the sweeping, sun-scorched expanse of Thousand Needles. The tauren outpost serves as a crucial Horde sanctuary in an otherwise hostile territory teeming with ferocious predators, quilboar, and aggressive centaur clans. Rau acts as both an outpost organizer and a dedicated investigator, keen on neutralizing emerging threats before they can overwhelm the vulnerable mesa settlements.

npc:razzle-sprysprocket.text: Razzle Sprysprocket. Razzle Sprysprocket is a gnomish engineer residing in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Known for his technical tinkering alongside Ozzie Togglevolt, he enlists travelers to help salvage disrupted gnomish machinery and components around the snowy hills. Following the tragedy at Gnomeregan, Razzle Sprysprocket found refuge among the snowdrifts of Dun Morogh, setting up his workshop in Kharanos. With a knack for delicate mechanical parts, Razzle works alongside fellow engineer Ozzie Togglevolt. Their efforts frequently involve recovering gyro-mechanisms and cog assemblies that were lost or scavenged during the flight from their irradiated homeland. Life in Dun Morogh is far from peaceful for a gnome inventor. Between the wild beasts of the frozen ridges and raids by local Frostmane trolls, Razzle's work is never entirely safe. Despite the dangers, he remains dedicated to keeping gnomish contraptions functional and recovering the lost wonders of Gnomeregan.

npc:red-jack-flint.text: Red Jack Flint. Red Jack Flint is a seasoned human mariner stationed within Menethil Keep in Menethil Harbor. A member of the crew of the vessel Maiden's Virtue, he serves as a point of contact for travelers seeking passage or contacts across the sea toward Kalimdor. Found inside the stone walls of Menethil Keep, Red Jack Flint is an experienced seafarer tied to the harbor's maritime trade. As part of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue, he navigates the dangerous sea routes linking the marshlands of Khaz Modan with distant shores. Rather than staying confined to naval routine, Flint directs capable adventurers to allies across the Great Sea, including contacts in Kalimdor like Fiora Longears.

npc:rema-schneider.text: Rema Schneider. In Stormwind City, Rema Schneider works from the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop. She is a human citizen who often helps local shopkeepers and artisans with trade deliveries. Rema Schneider manages daily trade from the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop. The shop stands just west of the stone bridge into Cathedral Square, along Stormwind's canals. Cloth and finished garments move between local craftsmen, and Rema relies on helpful couriers to carry supplies between workshops.

npc:remulos.text: Remulos. Keeper Remulos is a demigod son of Cenarius and the venerable protector of Moonglade. Alongside Archdruid Fandral Staghelm and Hamuul Runetotem, he helps guide the Cenarion Circle in the absence of his fallen father and the sleeping Malfurion Stormrage. Unlike Staghelm, Remulos prioritizes the broader balance of nature over night elven isolationism. Keeper Remulos is an immortal keeper of the grove, bearing the lower body of a great stag and the antlered torso of an ancient dryad-father. He watches over Moonglade, the sacred sanctuary of Azeroth's druids nestled north of Mount Hyjal. While Malfurion Stormrage remains trapped in the Emerald Dream, Remulos provides divine authority and counsel to the mortals of the Cenarion Circle. He remains deeply invested in healing Azeroth's scars, offering aid to druids pursuing their sacred rites around Lake Elune'ara. Remulos frequently finds himself at ideological odds with Archdruid Fandral Staghelm. While Staghelm champions night elven supremacy and sought to restore their lost immortality through Teldrassil, Remulos vehemently opposed the planting of the new World Tree as an act of hubris. Defying Staghelm's isolationist faction, Remulos welcomed Hamuul Runetotem and the tauren into the Cenarion Circle, sharing nature's closely guarded mysteries with their shamans-turned-druids to restore the land collectively.

npc:remy-two-times.text: Remy "Two Times". In Goldshire, Remy "Two Times" trades goods and pays for raw materials. He came from the Redridge Mountains and repeats the ends of his sentences. Remy "Two Times" trades from Goldshire, where he deals with travelers. He came west from the Redridge Mountains. When he speaks, he usually repeats the last words of each sentence twice. The odd habit gives him his nickname, but it does not keep him from seeking a profit in troubled Elwynn Forest. Kobolds overrun the local gold mines, and aggressive murlocs infest the riverbanks, disrupting trade in Elwynn. Remy turns to travelers for help. He pays for pouches of gold dust gathered from kobolds in the mines and keeps watch on suspicious murloc movements near Crystal Lake.

npc:renato-gallina.text: Renato Gallina. In Stormwind's Trade District, Renato Gallina calls travelers toward his family's winery. Renato Gallina calls to passers-by among the Trade District stalls, proclaiming his family's vintages the finest in Stormwind. The Gallina family runs a winery along the Canals, and Renato promotes it with pamphlets. Travelers can bring one to his sister Suzetta at the shop for a free bottle of wine.

npc:renee-lauer.text: Innkeeper Renee. Innkeeper Renee runs the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, offering shelter, food, and drink to the Forsaken and to Horde travelers passing through Tirisfal Glades. Renee keeps the Gallows' End Tavern, the inn at the heart of Brill. Behind her counter she sells food, drink and general goods, and she welcomes weary newcomers to rest their bones, remarking that the Forsaken certainly do have huge appetites. For the undead of Tirisfal, her tavern is a cozy little place where victims of the plague try to make their way in the world. Renee's inn is often a newcomer's first stop in Brill. Calvin Montague of Deathknell sends fresh adventurers to her with a nondescript letter, word she has been eagerly waiting for. Below her floorboards, the tavern's cellar also holds a captured Scarlet Crusade zealot.

npc:renzik-the-shiv.text: Renzik "The Shiv". In Stormwind's Old Town, Renzik "The Shiv" directs SI:7's new rogue recruits. The goblin is Spymaster Mathias Shaw's trusted second-in-command, receiving promising agents sent from across the Alliance. Renzik keeps his past to himself. In Stormwind, he is known as a goblin who rose to become Spymaster Mathias Shaw's second-in-command in SI:7. He has little patience for pleasantries. When new recruits arrive, he asks whether they are ready to work or need a nap first. Renzik works inside SI:7's secretive fortress in Old Town, second-in-command to Mathias Shaw. Rogue mentors across the Alliance, from Ironforge to Darnassus, send their most promising agents to him. He sends them to field instructors such as Lucius in Redridge, where they can hone the skills needed to survive in the field.

npc:rezlak.text: Rezlak. Along Durotar's roads south of Orgrimmar, Rezlak waits for help with his supply lines. The goblin entrepreneur belongs to the Tinkers' Union and hires travelers to recover missing supplies and drive off harpies. Rezlak waits beside the canyon road between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar. He represents the Tinkers' Union, a goblin syndicate focused on engineering, supply lines, and practical business. The factional tensions of Kalimdor matter little to him while trade runs smoothly. Dustwind harpies have raided his cargo caravans and made the routes unsafe. Rezlak remains at his post and hires passersby willing to earn a profit by recovering supplies and dealing with the harpies.

npc:rhinag.text: Rhinag. Among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border, Rhinag waits, weakened by scorpids' venom. The Darkspear troll depends on passing travelers to find him a remedy in time. Rhinag shelters among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border after a Venomtail Scorpid stung him. The poison has left the Darkspear troll weak and isolated. He needs a venomtail antidote, and his survival depends on whether a passing traveler can find one before the toxins take their toll.

npc:ringo.text: Ringo. Ringo is an unfortunate goblin explorer who ventured up the blistering heights of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Overwhelmed by the volcano's stifling heat and noxious vapors, he collapsed inside a cave, desperate for someone to help him back down. His close friend Spraggle Frock remains worried sick back at Marshal's Refuge. While goblins are known for braving hazardous environments in search of wealth or oddities, Fire Plume Ridge proves harsh even by their standards. Towering in the center of Un'Goro Crater, the active volcano spews ash, magma, and boiling steam. Ringo climbed about halfway up the southern face before the suffocating heat finally proved too much for him. Leaving his belongings scattered just outside, he crawled into a cave to shelter from the sweltering atmosphere, completely incapacitated by heat exhaustion.

npc:rivern-frostwind.text: Rivern Frostwind. Rivern Frostwind is a night elf riding instructor stationed high atop Frostsaber Rock in northern Winterspring. Accompanied by his frost tiger companion Glacier, he watches over the native wintersabers and trains riders deemed worthy by his order. Only the most dedicated champions of the Alliance are granted the honor of riding one of his prized mounts. Perched on the icy promontory of Frostsaber Rock, Rivern Frostwind oversees the breeding and stewardship of the legendary Winterspring frostsaber. While nightsabers roam the lush forests of Teldrassil and Ashenvale, their sub-arctic cousins are bred to endure the bitter cold of northern Kalimdor. Rivern acts as a gatekeeper for these majestic predators. He demands that outsiders prove their commitment to preserving the beasts—gathering fresh meat from the tundra, clearing out Winterfall furbolgs, and driving back rampaging frost giants—before he will even consider entrusting one of the sabers to them.

npc:roetten-stonehammer.text: Roetten Stonehammer. Roetten Stonehammer is an enterprising dwarf found wandering the Library in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. Representing the interests of Reclaimers Inc., he organizes expeditions and recruits adventurers to handle salvage operations in distant lands like Desolace. Amid the ancient tomes and dust of the Hall of Explorers' Library, Roetten Stonehammer keeps his eye on matters of practical recovery. Operating on behalf of Reclaimers Inc., Roetten connects daring mercenaries with lucrative salvage contracts across Kalimdor. Rather than digging purely for historical curiosity, his associates look to reclaim valuable cargo, wreckage, and rare reagents from perilous frontiers like the rugged wastes of Desolace.

npc:royal-historian-archesonus.text: Royal Historian Archesonus. Royal Historian Archesonus is a dwarven scholar serving King Magni Bronzebeard within Ironforge's High Seat. Renowned for her scholarly works documenting recent catastrophes in the northern human kingdoms, she also directs research into ancient dwarven tragedies, notably the scorched remains of the Dark Iron kingdom. Stationed steps from King Magni Bronzebeard's throne in the High Seat, Royal Historian Archesonus maintains historical records on behalf of the Ironforge crown. Her academic gaze extends well beyond the Khaz Modan mountains. She authored 'The Fall of Lordaeron and the Scouring of the Eastweald' as well as 'On Plagues, Curses, and Blights,' tracking the horrific collapse of humanity's northern realm under the Scourge. Rather than hiding from dark histories, Archesonus approaches disasters methodically, seeking to record the truth of ruinous magic and political collapse. In addition to her texts on Lordaeron, Archesonus oversees inquiries into the War of the Three Hammers and the catastrophic destruction of the city of Thaurissan. Seeking recovered relics and charred tablets from the Burning Steppes, she enlists adventurers to search the Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan. For Archesonus, understanding the cataclysm that scorched the Burning Steppes and bound the Dark Iron clan to the Firelord is vital statecraft—ensuring the Bronzebeard kingdom remembers exactly what sorcery and desperation can unleash.

npc:ruga-ragetotem.text: Ruga Ragetotem. At Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem trains warriors for the Horde. He tests them against the silithid in the southern Barrens before sending the proven toward custom armor. At Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem trains warriors who want to prove their strength in Kalimdor. Silithid have suddenly appeared to the south, carving hives into the Field of Giants. Ruga sends young fighters to hunt the insectoids and cut off their antennae. Those who endure the trial earn his respect and a recommendation to Thun'grim Firegaze, a renowned armorsmith.

npc:rutgar-glyphshaper.text: Rutgar Glyphshaper. Rutgar Glyphshaper is a dwarven archaeologist stationed at the Bronzebeard Encampment in the southern reaches of Silithus. As a member of Brann Bronzebeard's expedition, he studies ancient silithid relics and runes, striving to uncover the mystery of the hives even after Brann wanders off into the desert. Rutgar Glyphshaper traveled to Silithus under the leadership of Brann Bronzebeard to investigate the vast silithid hives and unearth lost relics buried beneath the desert wastes. Establishing their base at the Bronzebeard Encampment south of Cenarion Hold, Rutgar and his companions frequently ventured directly into the bug hives to harvest inscribed stones and runic artifacts, often cooperating with Cenarion night elf researchers.

npc:ruul-eagletalon.text: Ruul Eagletalon. Ruul Eagletalon is a tauren resident of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Stationed near the settlement's perimeter, he keeps a watchful eye on the local wildlife, particularly the aggressive Windfury harpies encroaching upon tauren lands. Ruul Eagletalon stands guard in Bloodhoof Village, tending to the security of the settlement as young braves arrive from Camp Narache. While Mulgore is a peaceful homeland compared to the arid wastes of the Barrens, territorial predators and hostile creatures continually press against the pastures. Ruul concerns himself with threats roaming the nearby plains, notably directing capable travelers to confront the savage Windfury harpies who prey on unwary nomads and game.

npc:ruul-snowhoof.text: Ruul Snowhoof. Ruul Snowhoof is a tauren druid held captive inside Thistlefur Hold in northern Ashenvale. Trapped in his bear form within a crude cage, he relies on Horde adventurers to break him out and guide him to safety. Ruul Snowhoof ventured into northern Ashenvale only to fall into the clutches of the corrupt Thistlefur furbolgs. When captured, he assumed the shape of a mighty bear—a guise his captors entirely mistook for an actual wild beast. Instead of slaying him outright, the furbolgs locked him inside a wooden cage deep within Thistlefur Hold, leaving him to slowly starve. Weakened and unable to safely drop his form or fight his way out alone, Ruul waits for allies of the Horde to spring his lock, fight off his jailers, and clear a path through the den so he can return to his sister, Yama Snowhoof, at Splintertree Post.

npc:rwag.text: Rwag. In the Den, Rwag teaches the first steps of a rogue's craft. The orc trains newly arrived orcs and trolls in stealth, subterfuge, and dirty fighting in Durotar's Valley of Trials, under the Horde's watch. Deep in the Den, Rwag trains fledgling rogues, cutpurses, and thieves before they venture beyond the cave into Durotar. The new Horde champions martial honor and battlefield valor, but Rwag knows subtlety, poisons, and a well-placed dagger remain tools for survival in the unforgiving desert. He keeps watch over business in the Valley and distrusts the dark practitioners sheltering in the cave, especially the warlock Nartok.

npc:saelienne.text: Saelienne. On the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, Saelienne keeps an inn for travelers and artisans. She offers food, drink, and a place to bind a Hearthstone in the night elven capital. Innkeeper Saelienne welcomes residents and visitors to her inn on Darnassus's Craftsmen's Terrace. She gives travelers a calm place to rest and serves night elven refreshments and goods brought through the city port. Tradesfolk come in after long hours at the forge or loom. Saelienne's inn gives them a place to gather and recover.

npc:sally-whitemane.text: High Inquisitor Whitemane. Whitemane is the High Inquisitor of the Scarlet Crusade, presiding over the Cathedral of the Scarlet Monastery. A powerful priestess of the Holy Light, her consuming hatred for the undead drives the Crusade's uncompromising zealotry. Together with Scarlet Commander Renault Mograine, she directs the order's military and ideological campaigns across Lordaeron. Rising rapidly through the Scarlet Crusade's hierarchy, Whitemane became its High Inquisitor and took command of the Scarlet Monastery's grand Cathedral. Renowned for her fearsome mastery of Holy magic, she has become one of the Crusade's foremost symbols through her absolute conviction, wielding the Light as an unrelenting weapon against any deemed unclean.

npc:salma-saldean.text: Salma Saldean. At Saldean's Farm, Salma Saldean keeps a welcome place for travelers. She and her husband, Farmer Saldean, tend the homestead in Westfall, where bandits threaten the farms and Stormwind has left the region. She offers meals in return for help around the farm. Salma Saldean welcomes travelers to a farm that has endured where neighboring homesteads have burned or fallen to the Defias Brotherhood. A hearty pot waits on the stove, and she looks for capable hands to help around the farmstead. Salma feeds her family and visitors with what Westfall provides. She teaches travelers to make Goretusk liver pie and Westfall stew with wild boar, vultures, murlocs, and stray okra.

npc:sara-balloo.text: Sara Balloo. Sara Balloo is a grieving dwarven widow residing in the Military Ward of Ironforge. She spends her days mourning her late husband, Sully Balloo, clinging to any remnant or message left behind from his final days in service. Standing within the bustling Military Ward of Ironforge, Sara Balloo presents a somber contrast to the clatter of weaponry and martial drills. Her husband, Sully Balloo, fell in battle far from home, leaving her alone with memories and lingering grief. For Sara, closure arrives only through recovered words—a final letter carrying Sully's devotion across the mountains from the scene of his demise.

npc:sara-timberlain.text: Sara Timberlain. At Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain stitches gear for the Stormwind Army. She makes useful armaments from salvaged cloth and leather. Sara Timberlain works with needle and thread outside a small cottage on the western edge of Eastvale Logging Camp. Axes sound through the camp as workers fell trees. Though Eastvale lies far from settled lands, wolves and murlocs prowl nearby, and Sara still offers travelers hospitality. She turns scraps of linen and salvaged bandanas into sturdy gear. Her skill has earned official recognition and commissions to supply cloth and leather armaments to Stormwind's military forces.

npc:scooty.text: Scooty. Scooty is a goblin engineer operating out of the bustling pirate port of Booty Bay. Proclaiming himself a master of engineering, he maintains a delicate transponder setup linked directly to an experimental teleporter in the fallen city of Gnomeregan. His contraptions offer Horde operatives a direct, if perilous, technological bypass right into the heart of Dun Morogh. Operating amid the wharves and workshops of Booty Bay, Scooty holds court as one of the Steamwheedle Cartel's most ambitious tinkerers. While typical goblins obsess over gunpowder and explosives, Scooty turned his attention to instantaneous molecular transport. By calibrating complex transponder systems, he manages a direct operational link to a teleportation pad situated inside Gnomeregan. Horde forces looking to breach the subterranean gnome stronghold rely heavily on Scooty's tinkering to bypass treacherous Alliance territory altogether. Maintaining experimental goblin teleporters is rarely a dull enterprise. Scooty and his partner Sovik built the Transpolyporter 6000 after word reached them of a new gnomish rig in Gnomeregan, and by Scooty's own cheerful admission it has only exploded a dozen or so times. Despite the obvious physical perils involved in being dematerialized across continents, Scooty remains entirely confident in his genius, dismissing every catastrophic mechanical hiccup as merely a minor obstacle on the road to true innovation.

npc:scout-riell.text: Scout Riell. At Sentinel Hill, Scout Riell watches Westfall from the watchtower roof. She serves the People's Militia, tracking the Defias Brotherhood and calling on travelers to bring back the outlaws' red silk bandanas. Scout Riell watches the plains from the stone tower at Sentinel Hill, where banditry and harvest golems threaten Westfall. Stormwind's royal army is absent, and the crown refuses aid, leaving the People's Militia to defend the region. From the tower roof, Riell tracks the Defias Brotherhood's movements and gathers proof of their crimes. She calls on passing travelers to take red silk bandanas from the bandits.

npc:scout-thaelrid.text: Argent Guard Thaelrid. Argent Guard Thaelrid is a wounded night elf scout sent by the Argent Dawn into the submerged ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. Trapped near the Pool of Ask'ar, he bears witness to the dark alliance taking root between the naga and the Twilight's Hammer cult. When strange reports trickled out of the Zoram Strand concerning foul rites deep beneath the sea, the Argent Dawn took interest. Dedicated to watching for rising evils and unnatural corruption across Azeroth, the order dispatched Scout Thaelrid to slip inside Blackfathom Deeps. His mission was simple: assess the depth of the threat, observe the movements within the flooded temple, and report back so the Dawn could decide where aid was most desperately needed.

npc:searn-firewarder.text: Searn Firewarder. In Grommash Hold, Searn Firewarder guides Horde shamans toward the elements. Inside Grommash Hold, Searn Firewarder guides shamans seeking the elements. Many Darkspear trolls commune with spirits through witch doctors and voodoo rituals. Searn guides initiates toward distant mentors and rites for the Call of Fire, Call of Water, and Call of Air, which teach them to commune with the elemental spirits of fire, water, and air. He stands among the Horde's high command in Orgrimmar.

npc:seer-graytongue.text: Seer Graytongue. Seer Graytongue is a venerable tauren elder and spiritual guide residing on Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. Stationed near Camp Narache, he tests young braves undertaking their earliest tribal trials. Through rituals such as the Rite of Strength, he ensures that the youth honor the Earthmother before stepping into the wider world. Seer Graytongue makes his home atop Red Cloud Mesa, serving as an early instructor for aspiring tauren braves and spellweavers. As young adventurers set forth from Camp Narache, Graytongue oversees critical steps of their sacred passage, including the Rites of the Earthmother. By testing their resolve against the harsh plains and dangerous beasts of Mulgore, he instills the virtues of honor, patience, and reverence that every true tauren must carry into adulthood.

npc:seer-ravenfeather.text: Seer Ravenfeather. Seer Ravenfeather is a tauren shaman instructor stationed at Camp Narache on the Red Cloud Mesa. She guides fledging spiritualists through their early trials, helping them attune to the voices of the spirits and the land of Mulgore. Standing within the quiet shelters of Camp Narache, Seer Ravenfeather serves as a patient teacher for young tauren called to walk the shamanic path. The Red Cloud Mesa is a sacred proving ground, and Ravenfeather ensures that novice practitioners understand their duties before venturing into the wider expanses of Mulgore. She instructs them in the foundational rites needed to commune with elemental forces and honor the Earth Mother. Ravenfeather's primary charge is overseeing the initial spiritual steps of nascent shamans, directing them in the traditional rite known as the Call of Earth. Through her guidance, initiates prepare ceremonial saptas and seek communion with the earthen spirits nestled within the mesa's stony outcrops, forging a bond that anchors their elemental magic.

npc:seereth-stonebreak.text: Seereth Stonebreak. Near Greatwood Vale, Seereth Stonebreak watches the land's disturbances. The orc shaman camps on the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens, guiding travelers against environmental ruin, rogue machines, and rising tensions in Kalimdor. Seereth Stonebreak watches over Horde lands from her camp near Greatwood Vale. An orc shaman, she follows the harmony of the elements and protects the territories of the Horde. The land's spirits cried out against goblin plunder, and the Horde sent her to Stonetalon. There, she watches the landscape and guides travelers against dangers threatening the wild frontier. Seereth Stonebreak is troubled by turmoil across the Stonetalon range. Ruthless goblin ventures and mechanical shredders cutting through ancient woodlands have badly fractured the mountains' spiritual balance. She sends Horde envoys to confront the invaders and seek counsel from elder lorekeepers, in hopes of easing the land's distress.

npc:senator-mehr-stonehallow.text: Senator Mehr Stonehallow. Senator Mehr Stonehallow is an Ironforge politician and member of the Explorers' League stationed at the Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh. Rather than debating policy in the capital, he has traveled to the front lines to personally oversee the containment of the local trogg infestation. He enlists eager adventurers to cull the beasts before they overrun the quarry completely. While most members of the Ironforge Senate spend their days safely sequestered within the great stone halls of the capital, Senator Mehr Stonehallow prefers direct action. As a dwarf dedicated both to governance and the historical pursuits of the Explorers' League, he understands the practical dangers facing the realm. When vicious Rockjaw troggs began clawing out of the deep rock in Gol'Bolar Quarry, Stonehallow made the journey to the mining pit himself. Convinced that bureaucratic posturing will not save the workers, he offers bounties to capable travelers to eradicate the aggressive troggs and reclaim the quarry.

npc:senior-surveyor-fizzledowser.text: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser. Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser is a goblin researcher working from Gadgetzan in Tanaris. He investigates disruptions around the local water supply and sends adventurers to look into the disappearance of Scrimshank.

npc:sentinel-arynia-cloudsbreak.text: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak. At Oracle Glade on Teldrassil, Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak watches over the northern groves. She guards the enchanted waters and woodland wildlife. Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak keeps watch in Oracle Glade, one of Teldrassil's most secluded reaches. Far from Darnassus, she serves the Sentinel army among ancient trees and ethereal springs, guarding the wilderness from disturbance. Disharmony stirs among Teldrassil's creatures despite the tree's sacred birth. Arynia asks passing adventurers and young night elves to look into local troubles, from strange wildlife to mystical signs around the enchanted springs.

npc:sentinel-aynasha.text: Sentinel Aynasha. Along Darkshore’s wild borders, Sentinel Aynasha scouts the dangers threatening night elven lands. She watches enemy movements and carries urgent intelligence across the frontier. Sentinel Aynasha scouts and fights with the Sentinels where night elven lands meet hostile incursions. She carries urgent messages across rough country and watches for enemy patrols. Her skill with a bow and her knowledge of survival help her cross contested ground.

npc:sentinel-elissa-starbreeze.text: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze. In Auberdine, Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze watches over the misty coast of Darkshore. From the upper floor of a lodge across the bridge, she tracks growing threats and directs travelers toward dangers in the wilderness. Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze coordinates Auberdine's defenses from across the bridge. While other Sentinels patrol Darkshore's coast and woodlands, she watches from the upper floor of a building northeast of the town inn. She keeps alert for unusual disturbances across the region. Her directions send travelers to distant places, including the Tower of Althalaxx far to the north, so threats in the shadows do not catch Auberdine unaware.

npc:sentinel-farsong.text: Sentinel Farsong. Sentinel Farsong is a night elf sentinel stationed at Silverwing Grove in Ashenvale. Serving as a crucial liaison for the Silverwing Sentinels, she coordinates intelligence and combat efforts against the encroaching Warsong Outriders in Warsong Gulch. Standing vigil within Silverwing Grove, Sentinel Farsong is deeply involved in the defense of Ashenvale's southern border. With the Warsong clan continuously harvesting lumber and pushing deeper into ancestral night elf territories, she mobilizes Alliance champions to strike at Warsong Outriders and ensures field reports reach Silverwing command. Her duties center on rallying volunteers to check the Horde's territorial expansion and preserve the sacred woods.

npc:sentinel-onaeya.text: Sentinel Onaeya. Sentinel Onaeya is a night elf guardian stationed at Maestra's Post in northwestern Ashenvale, near the border with Darkshore. Tasked with holding the line against encroaching perils, she rallies capable Alliance adventurers to safeguard the forest and aid fellow sentinels. Maestra's Post serves as a critical wayside outpost along the road from Darkshore into the dense, contested canopy of Ashenvale. Sentinel Onaeya stands guard outside the settlement's main lodge, keeping a vigilant watch over travelers and coordinating defensive actions. Between hostile wildlife, corrupting forces, and border tensions, sentinels like Onaeya represent the first line of defense for night elf settlements in the region. Onaeya receives news of Sentinel Aynasha, who is attacked by furbolgs while carrying an important message through Darkshore. She rewards adventurers who protect the poisoned sentinel until her antidote takes effect.

npc:sentinel-selarin.text: Sentinel Selarin. Sentinel Selarin is a night elf scout dispatched to the coastal settlement of Auberdine. Acting as an emissary for the defenders of Ashenvale, she seeks reinforcements to help stem the rising perils threatening the ancient forest. As tensions and dark threats mount across Ashenvale, the garrison there has found its resources stretched to the breaking point. Under the direction of Raene Wolfrunner, Sentinel Selarin traveled north along the forest road into Darkshore. Her mission was straightforward: seek out Terenthis in Auberdine and request assistance from the sentinels and scouts stationed on the coast. Upon arriving in Auberdine, Selarin found Terenthis thoroughly consumed by local duties and unable to personally answer the call. Rather than returning empty-handed, Selarin resolved to remain in town and enlist capable travelers passing through Darkshore. She directs proven adventurers south toward Astranaar, urging them to lend their blades and spells to Raene Wolfrunner's beleaguered forces.

npc:sentinel-thenysil.text: Sentinel Thenysil. Sentinel Tara Thenysil is a night elf sentinel stationed in Astranaar within the ancient forest of Ashenvale. Vigilant over the surrounding wilderness, she keeps close tabs on military operations in the region and coordinates scouts watching neighboring territories. Her attention is particularly focused on allied movements pushing south into the contested Stonetalon Mountains. From her post in the fortified settlement of Astranaar, Sentinel Thenysil helps secure Ashenvale against growing hostility. Night elf holdings throughout the region face relentless encroachment, making communications between distant outposts vital. While much of the local garrison focuses directly on defending the forest road, Thenysil directs Alliance volunteers beyond Ashenvale's borders to ensure distant allies remain supported. Thenysil maintains a close personal and military friendship with Kaela Shadowspear, an operative deployed south into the crags of the Stonetalon Mountains. Learning that Kaela was dispatched alongside an eccentric gnome mage, Thenysil considered the unorthodox pairing an unmistakable sign of serious trouble brewing in the peaks. Wary of what dangers her comrade might face, she recruits capable adventurers to journey south, deliver support, and report on the unfolding mission.

npc:sentinel-tysha-moonblade.text: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade. Along Darkshore’s road, Sentinel Tysha Moonblade watches a troubled coast. The night elf scout stands west of Ameth'Aran, guiding travelers and seeking help with the restless spirits haunting the nearby ruins. Sentinel Tysha Moonblade watches the road through Darkshore. East of her lie the ruins of Ameth'Aran, where cursed Highborne ghosts and malevolent banshees linger among ancient stone pillars. Auberdine's defenses are stretched thin by dangers along the coast, so Tysha asks capable travelers to uncover the history of Ameth'Aran's fall and put down its restless dead.

npc:sentinel-velene-starstrike.text: Sentinel Velene Starstrike. Sentinel Velene Starstrike is a night elf guardian stationed at Silverwind Refuge in central Ashenvale. Tasked with protecting the sanctuary and the surrounding waters, she confronts encroaching unnatural threats such as rogue elementals and foul sorcerers. Her vigilance helps safeguard the ancient woodland from corrupting magical interference. Stationed beside the clear waters of Mystral Lake, Sentinel Velene Starstrike maintains a watchful vigil from Silverwind Refuge. Like many night elf sentinels scattered throughout Ashenvale, her primary duty is preserving the balance of the forest and repelling threats to elven sanctuaries. The serene grove serves as a vital rest stop for travelers traversing the central woods, making her presence essential to the area's ongoing safety. The peace around Silverwind Refuge is fragile. Velene keeps close watch over Mystral Lake, where erratic elemental spirits and reckless mage summoners disrupt the natural rhythm of the wilderness. Through her direction, champions are dispatched to suppress rogue water elementals and put an end to the careless practitioners disturbing the spirits of the land.

npc:serge-hinott.text: Serge Hinott. In Tarren Mill, Serge Hinott brews mixtures for the Forsaken war effort. The Forsaken alchemist works alongside Apothecary Lydon, preparing concoctions, antidotes, and reagents for the Royal Apothecary Society. Serge Hinott brews remedies and other mixtures for the Forsaken in Tarren Mill. He works beside Apothecary Lydon, whose work includes chemical development and plague research against nearby human settlements such as Southshore. Hinott handles specialized brewing, including restorative salves and antidotes for field agents and scouts who face poisons or other toxic mishaps.

npc:shanda.text: Shanda. In Aldrassil, Shanda guides young night elf priests in the ways of Elune. She serves the Sisterhood of Elune in Shadowglen, teaching prayers, wards, and rites as her students prepare to defend Teldrassil. Shanda guides young night elves devoted to Elune from within Aldrassil. While druids tend Teldrassil's roots and boughs, priestesses keep the Kaldorei close to the White Lady. Shanda teaches new initiates to call on lunar grace for healing and protective wards, preparing them to face the corruption creeping into the World Tree's boughs. Young priests who awaken to their calling in Shadowglen come to Shanda to prove their devotion and learn their first prayers. Through rites such as In Favor of Elune, she tests their resolve, gives them blessed regalia, and teaches basic incantations. Her students learn to tend the wounded with a gentle hand and stand firm against the shadows.

npc:shandris-feathermoon.text: Shandris Feathermoon. Shandris Feathermoon is the General of the Sentinel Army and, for ten thousand years, Tyrande Whisperwind's right hand. She now commands night elf military forces throughout Kalimdor from Feathermoon Stronghold on Sardor Isle off the coast of Feralas. Shandris Feathermoon is one of the oldest defenders of the night elves. For ten thousand years she has served at Tyrande Whisperwind's side as the high priestess's right hand among the Sentinels, through the long vigil that followed the Sundering. Following the Great Sundering and the founding of the Sentinels, Shandris became an indispensable commander within the night elf military. Today, General Feathermoon serves as the supreme field commander of the Sentinel army. Stationed on Sardor Isle, she oversees Feathermoon Stronghold, an imposing elven fortress that keeps watch over the primal wilds of Feralas. From this island outpost, she monitors the encroaching threats of savage gnolls, lingering Gordunni ogres, hate-fueled satyrs, and the expanding power of the Horde in southern Kalimdor.

npc:shari-stilwell.text: Shari Stilwell. Shari Stilwell is a Forsaken paladin trainer stationed in the settlement of Brill within Tirisfal Glades. Bearing a surname shared with notable figures in the Eastern Kingdoms, she instructs Forsaken who take up the mantle of holy warriors. Her presence marks a rare and unconventional discipline among the undead under the Banshee Queen. Found among the blight-touched buildings of Brill, Shari Stilwell stands out as a mentor to Forsaken holy warriors. While the holy Light is excruciating to the undead, Shari guides fledgling Forsaken who endure that agonizing path. She aids newcomers seeking their footing in Tirisfal Glades through their early training and adjustments, offering guidance to those looking to secure a place within the Forsaken kingdom. Shari shares her family name with several living figures scattered across the southern kingdoms, including Daphne, Merissa, and the renowned smith Jordan Stilwell. Whether she was torn away from these kin during the fall of Lordaeron or shares only a distant lineage remains an unspoken tragedy of the Scourge's devastation.

npc:shelene-rhobart.text: Shelene Rhobart. Shelene Rhobart is a Forsaken leatherworking trainer stationed along the road in Tirisfal Glades. Operating out of a Deathguard waystation, she supplies cured hides and leathercraft training to support the Forsaken's military and logistical efforts across the blighted lands. Shelene Rhobart plies her trade at a Deathguard waystation, an outpost situated southeast of Brill along the main road toward the ruins of Lordaeron. Even in undeath, practical crafts remain essential for survival and war. Shelene works with animal pelts collected from the prowling beasts of Tirisfal, refining tough hides into armor, straps, and field gear to supply local Forsaken patrols contending with both the Scourge and Scarlet crusaders.

npc:shindrell-swiftfire.text: Shindrell Swiftfire. Shindrell Swiftfire is a night elf sentinel and scout stationed in Astranaar, the heart of night elf operations in Ashenvale. Keenly aware of shifting perils along Kalimdor's western reaches, she directs capable Alliance adventurers toward gathering threats on the coastline and nearby mountain passes. Her duties make her an essential hub for coordinating local defense against emerging oceanic and wild menaces. From Astranaar's winding walkways, Shindrell Swiftfire serves as an alert observer of Ashenvale's broader frontiers. While the forest's Sentinels are constantly pressured by the Horde's logging incursions from the east and south, Shindrell keeps her eyes fixed on dangers that lie beyond the immediate woodland front. She acts as a vital liaison for travelers arriving from Darkshore or heading out toward the jagged ridges of Stonetalon, ensuring no sudden menace strikes Astranaar undefended from the flank. Among Shindrell's primary concerns is the troubled Zoram Strand on Ashenvale's northwestern shore. The sudden emergence of hostile naga crawling from the ocean depths poses a grave mystery and direct threat to the Kaldorei settlements. By dispatching seasoned fighters to investigate the shoreline and coordinate with scouts closer to the scene, Shindrell works to contain the serpentine invaders before they secure a permanent foothold on ancient night elf lands.

npc:shoni-the-shilent.text: Shoni the Shilent. Shoni the Shilent is an industrious gnome engineer stationed in Stormwind City's bustling Dwarven District. As commander of the Gnomeregan underground assault crew, she directs Alliance adventurers into the Deadmines to salvage the power supply of a goblin shredder, fuel for the machines she hopes will break a path back into Gnomeregan. Operating out of the smoky workshops of the Dwarven District, Shoni represents gnomish strategic ingenuity far from the lost halls of Gnomeregan. Her engineering plans are ambitious. With Gnomeregan in the hands of the troggs, Shoni is organizing an underground assault to retake it, and she sends operatives into the subterranean tunnels beneath Westfall for the parts her crew needs. Shoni's plan rests on the gnomes' own gyrodrillmatic excavationators, heavy drilling machines meant to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan and open the way for a gnomish assault. They lack the power to do it, so she wants the intact power supply, the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, from a working goblin shredder deep in the Deadmines. Later, she also sends adventurers into Gnomeregan itself to tear apart its robots for spare parts to repair her fleet.

npc:sicco-thermaplugg.text: Mekgineer Thermaplugg. Mekgineer Thermaplugg is the self-proclaimed ruler of ruined Gnomeregan and the greatest traitor in gnomish history. Once the trusted chief advisor of High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, he orchestrated the catastrophic irradiation of the underground city in a twisted bid to seize power. Now thoroughly deranged and transformed into a leper gnome, he commands the irradiated halls from within a massive mechanical battle suit. Mekgineer Thermaplugg served for many years as chief advisor to High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, who trusted him completely. All the while, Thermaplugg secretly coveted the office of High Tinker. What finally drove him to betray that trust, whether power or wealth, not even Mekkatorque can say; the High Tinker can only note that Thermaplugg would have had both in time.

npc:sida.text: Sida. Sida is a dwarven resident of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Known for her estranged marriage to Einar Stonegrip, she spends her days in the port town while dealing with personal misadventures out in the surrounding marshes. Sida resides in the bustling Alliance port of Menethil Harbor, living apart from her husband, Einar Stonegrip. Their relationship is strained enough that Einar flatly refuses to travel to Menethil so long as Sida remains in town. Despite keeping to the coastal settlement, Sida occasionally ventures out into the dangers of the Wetlands, having recently suffered the misfortune of losing her personal bag during an expedition out toward Ironbeard's Tomb.

npc:sirra-von-indi.text: Sirra Von'Indi. Sirra Von'Indi is the resident historian of Darkshire, stationed within the town hall amid stacks of forgotten records. Versed in ancient languages and local history, he assists the township in deciphering mysterious documents and uncovering the dark past of Duskwood. Sirra Von'Indi serves as Darkshire's foremost scholar, keeping watch over the settlement's archives from inside the Darkshire Town Hall. While the town guard focuses on the immediate threats lurking in the woods, Sirra turns his attention to the written word, translating cryptic texts and preserving the fading history of Grand Hamlet before the shadow fell across the region.

npc:sister-aquinne.text: Sister Aquinne. In Darnassus, Sister Aquinne studies beneath the Priesthood of Elune at the Temple of the Moon. The novice acolyte serves in the Temple Gardens. Sister Aquinne studies with the Priesthood of Elune in the night elf capital. She is stationed in the Temple Gardens, beneath the Temple of the Moon, learning from the High Priestess and elder sisters. When a once-great creature of the forest needed help, Aquinne sent willing travelers to Priestess A'moora inside the temple to learn what had to be done.

npc:skorn-whitecloud.text: Skorn Whitecloud. Skorn Whitecloud is an aging tauren hunter residing at Bloodhoof Village in the rolling plains of Mulgore. He guides young hunters in understanding their relationship with the land's predators and aids travelers who cross paths with Mulgore's lurking dangers. Living at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, Skorn Whitecloud is an old hunter who now serves as an instructor in the ways of the hunt. His primary role is instilling respect for the wild creatures of the plains. He tests aspiring hunters by sending them after the claws of Mulgore's cunning flatland prowlers, to be shown to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff, ensuring that those who take up the bow or spear understand the balance between predator and prey.

npc:skuerto.text: Skuerto. Skuerto is a dwarven scout stationed at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands. Sent there by Archmage Malin alongside Apprentice Kryten, he aids the Alliance in the field, helping secure magical relics on Malin's behalf. Skuerto, a dwarf of Ironforge, works as a scout in the dangerous Arathi Highlands. Stationed alongside Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe, he works under the direction of Archmage Malin to recover arcane reagents and potent magical artifacts that once belonged to Malin's old master, Archmage Trelane. Despite the harsh conditions of the Highlands, Skuerto takes considerable pride in his wilderness scouting and reacts poorly to anyone questioning his competence. His work regularly brushes up against regional perils, from the hostile Syndicate and Boulderfist ogres to dangerous ancient entities tied to the land.

npc:smith-argus.text: Smith Argus. Smith Argus is the resident blacksmith and trainer stationed in the heart of Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. From his open-air forge near the Lion's Pride Inn, he repairs traveler gear, teaches novice smiths their fundamentals, and coordinates with craftsmen across southern Azeroth. His network ties Goldshire's local trade directly to logistical hubs like Stormwind and distant frontiers like Redridge. Situated just outside the Lion's Pride Inn, Smith Argus maintains one of the busiest anvils in Elwynn Forest. While Goldshire faces growing perils from nearby gnolls, kobolds, and Defias bandits, Argus keeps local militia and passing adventurers properly equipped. In addition to mending dented armor and forging sturdy implements, he serves as a blacksmithing trainer, initiating fledgling craftsmen into the fundamentals of working copper and bronze. Argus is not an isolated village smith; his workshop is a vital link in the Kingdom of Stormwind's regional supply chain. When craftsmen in neighboring settlements require specialized gear or raw materials, they look to Goldshire's central position. Farrier Verner Osgood in Redridge relies on Argus for shipments of crafted horseshoes to keep pack animals and cavalry moving, while metalworkers in Stormwind's Dwarven District regularly coordinate deliveries through him.

npc:solm-hargrin.text: Solm Hargrin. Solm Hargrin is the rogue trainer stationed within Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. A pragmatic dwarf who values honor amongst thieves, he instructs novice dwarven and gnomish scoundrels in the art of subterfuge. He firmly believes that covert operatives will prove vital as geopolitical tensions simmer across Azeroth. Tucked away in the dwarven stronghold of Anvilmar, Solm Hargrin watches the snowy passes of Coldridge Valley with a keen, calculating eye. While Ironforge relies heavily on the brute strength of its mountaineers and warriors, Hargrin understands that some threats require a quieter, sharper touch. He welcomes budding rogues of both dwarven and gnomish heritage, deciphering coded missives for them and drilling them in essential techniques like Eviscerate. Above all, Hargrin champions a creed of professional loyalty and honor among thieves, preparing his pupils for an increasingly volatile world where subtle knives often shape the fate of nations.

npc:sprite-darter.text: Sprite Darter. Sprite Darters are small, iridescent faerie dragons native to the lush canopy of Feralas. Revered for their innate spiritual and magical qualities, they flit gracefully among the ancient trees. Recently, these rare creatures have become targets for local Grimtotem tauren who seek to capture and exploit them. Sprite Darters are elusive, winged woodland beasts native to the ancient forests of Feralas. Characterized by their gleaming, iridescent wings and mysterious spiritual essence, they embody the whimsical yet fierce magical ecology of Kalimdor's deep forests. Though generally peaceful and shy, their innate resistance to magical forces and natural power make them significant to those attuned to the wilderness. In recent times, the reclusive Sprite Darters have faced an unprecedented threat. The aggressive Grimtotem tauren clan inhabiting Feralas has begun rounding up and caging large numbers of these rare creatures for enigmatic purposes. Concerned night elves like Kindal Moonweaver actively recruit allies to disrupt the cages and liberate the trapped hatchlings before the Grimtotem bend them to their will. Beyond night elf efforts to safeguard them, the darters have caught the eye of outside observers studying primal power. Witch Doctor Uzer'i, a troll spiritualist operating out of Camp Mojache, takes a keen interest in the natural energies and muisek contained within the Sprite Darters, seeking their essence to unravel the unique magic thriving throughout Feralas.

npc:stitches.text: Stitches. Stitches is a colossal, stitched-together undead abomination stalking Duskwood's main thoroughfare. His march threatens travelers, the Night Watch, and the town of Darkshire. Stitches is an undead abomination assembled from harvested corpses and unholy sorcery. Appearing near Abercrombie's shack northeast of Raven Hill Cemetery, the lumbering monstrosity immediately sets out eastward along the road toward Darkshire. Imbued with immense physical strength and relentless malice, Stitches tears through any Night Watch checkpoints stationed along the thoroughfare—including the defense camp across from Vul'Gol Ogre Mound and the outpost outside the Rotting Orchard—bringing outright slaughter to unwary travelers and town defenders alike.

npc:supervisor-raelen.text: Supervisor Raelen. At Eastvale Logging Camp, Supervisor Raelen keeps timber moving toward Stormwind. She manages the laborers, tracks daily quotas, and oversees the lumber supply. Supervisor Raelen directs the woodcutters at Eastvale Logging Camp, near Marshal Patterson and the camp’s wagons. The camp stands on the edge of eastern Elwynn, near the Redridge Mountains, where the work brings its share of trouble. Raelen coordinates the crews and keeps them focused on their quotas despite hazards in the surrounding woods. She sees that gathered timber is processed, bundled, and sent on toward Stormwind.

npc:suzetta-gallina.text: Suzetta Gallina. At the Gallina Winery in Stormwind City, Suzetta Gallina tends the family wine business. Suzetta Gallina helps run the Gallina Winery along Stormwind's Canals. The shop offers wines imported from across the kingdom or crafted there. Her family supplies taverns, nobles, and common folk. Suzetta is no figure in high politics, but her work keeps the capital's trade moving through troubled times.

npc:syral-bladeleaf.text: Syral Bladeleaf. In Dolanaar, Syral Bladeleaf guides night elves arriving from Shadowglen. As a resident of Teldrassil, she speaks for the Council of the Forest and directs them to local caretakers, herbalists, and elders who watch over the crown's boughs. Syral Bladeleaf helps direct new arrivals through Dolanaar beneath Teldrassil's canopy. She speaks for the Council of the Forest, sending night elves to community leaders and herbalists in the village and nearby wilderness. Her guidance leads travelers to Denalan, a botanist at Lake Al'Ameth, and helps them replenish supplies for the village elders. In Dolanaar, Syral carries out the Council of the Forest's work for the village. She helps see that medicinal elixirs reach those in need and that disruptions to the local ecosystem receive swift attention.

npc:syurna.text: Syurna. In Darnassus, Syurna trains night elf rogues in the Cenarion Enclave. She guides aspiring scouts, spies, and covert operatives, then sends new rogues on trials of stealth and cunning. Syurna trains those who move unseen through Darnassus. In the Cenarion Enclave, she teaches rogues evasion, lockpicking, and lethal strikes. The Sentinels display the Kaldorei’s martial strength, while the Sisterhood of Elune holds its spiritual wisdom. The Kaldorei also depend on shadows and stealth, and Syurna sharpens the eyes and blades that guard Teldrassil. Syurna tests young operatives beyond the lessons taught in the enclave. She sends promising initiates into deeper fieldwork to see whether they have the instincts to survive beyond the World Tree’s boughs and serve the Alliance in perilous frontier lands.

npc:tabetha.text: Tabetha. Tabetha is a reclusive, powerful human mage dwelling deep within Dustwallow Marsh at an isolated farmstead in the Quagmire. Far from the politics of Dalaran or Theramore, she instructs aspiring spellcasters and aids those seeking mastery over potent arcane and occult relics. Hidden away in the sodden expanse of Dustwallow Marsh north of the Stonemaul Ruins, Tabetha lives in a secluded shack alongside her apprentices. Surrounding herself with alchemical vials and ancient tomes, she has deliberately chosen solitude over the academic hierarchies of the Eastern Kingdoms. Despite her remote location, her mastery of the arcane is renowned enough that spellcasters across Kalimdor brave beasts and mire alike to seek her guidance. Tabetha stands notably apart from factional hostilities. While human by birth, she turns away neither Alliance nor Horde initiates who demonstrate the will to learn, providing tutelage to mages and assisting warlocks with dangerous bindings such as the Orb of Orahil. Her past connects her to figures like Menara Voidrender, revealing an extensive history with esoteric magic that transcends simple faction allegiance.

npc:tai-jin.text: Tai'jin. At the Razor Hill barracks, Tai'jin guides young Darkspear priests in their spiritual traditions. She teaches the balance of light and shadow and rites such as the Hex of Weakness. Tai'jin guides young priests from the Razor Hill barracks as they set out into Durotar. Orcs here turn chiefly to shamanism or warlock arts, while Darkspear trolls bring their communion with spirits and loas to the Horde. Tai'jin teaches the first principles of priesthood, the balance of light and shadow, and the spiritual heritage of troll culture.

npc:taiga-wisemane.text: Taiga Wisemane. Taiga Wisemane is a tauren elder residing in Shadowprey Village along the rugged western coast of Desolace. Watchful of demonic meddling across the barren wastes, he works to thwart the Burning Blade cult entrenched in the region. He directs Horde champions to disrupt demonic rituals and seal open gateways before the Burning Legion gains ground. Though Shadowprey Village is predominantly a Darkspear troll fishing settlement tucked away against the ocean, Taiga Wisemane has taken up station there to monitor the dark sorceries stirring across Desolace. He remains acutely aware of the spiritual corruption bleeding into the soil, keeping his focus fixed eastward where shadow cults and demonic remnants fester among ancient ruins.

npc:takar-the-seer.text: Takar the Seer. East of Camp Taurajo, Takar the Seer keeps a lone camp in the Barrens. Though surrounded by Horde lands, he remains loyal to the Alliance and shares occult knowledge with certain travelers. Takar the Seer lives alone beneath a simple tent east of Camp Taurajo. Tauren braves and orc patrols watch the surrounding Barrens, yet leave his remote clearing undisturbed. He distrusts curious Horde visitors but rarely starts a fight, keeping watch on the horizon and to himself. His camp lies far from Stormwind's politics. Takar the Seer shares his knowledge with a few visitors from beyond his camp. Alliance warlocks who come from the Eastern Kingdoms seek his cryptic counsel when they try to bind dangerous beings from beyond this world. His understanding of hidden forces and the craft of souls draws these practitioners to his remote, perilous camp.

npc:takata-steelblade.text: Takata Steelblade. Takata Steelblade is an orc warrior stationed at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. Dispatched from Orgrimmar by Keldran alongside Maurin Bonesplitter, he spearheads the Horde's local campaign against demonic corruption. His primary focus is eradicating the regional satyr population affiliated with the sinister Burning Blade.
